name: Camp TAG (The Allergy Gang)
description_short: A one-week day camp for children ages 4-13 with food allergies, eosinophilic disorders, FPIES, celiac disease, eczema, asthma or mast cell disorders, and their siblings without allergies. Days are mostly regular camp activities, plus age-appropriate lessons on managing allergies and using epinephrine.
special_needs_notes: For kids with food allergies, eosinophilic disorders, FPIES, celiac disease, eczema, asthma or mast cell disorders. Camp nurses are on site at all times. Each group's counselor carries the children's medications in a portable cooler. Medications are checked in each morning and out each afternoon. Every camper needs a completed medical/health plan. Peanuts, tree nuts, fish, shellfish and sesame are banned, and so are milk/cheese-based foods and egg-based condiments. Families pack lunch; the camp provides top-9-free snacks and bottled water. There is 1 counselor for every 5 children.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming and canoeing are listed among the daily activities. No details are given about supervision or swim tests.

warnings: The URL slug says 'hinsdale-massachusetts', but the page lists only two 2027 locations: Lebanon, OH and Nashville, TN. No Massachusetts session appears. The URL may be stale.
There are two locations in different states, so city/state/zip were left blank. Each session is named for its location.
Camper prices are not on this page. The $175 (Ohio) and $425 (Nashville) fees are for teen counselors, not campers.
Tuition must be paid in full at registration, so there is no deposit option. Registration opens January 1, 2027.
